_how: How the homepage illustration reacts. poses: the picture (or short loop of pictures) for each mood. A loop uses frames, fps (pictures per second) and breathe (a gentle body motion). Missing files are skipped, and a pose with no files uses the standing illustration, so nothing breaks. moments: what he says and which pose he uses as each part of the page comes into view. Edit the words freely; leave say empty for no bubble. See notes/character-prompt.md for how to make the pictures.
